title: Engineered wood products.
officialText:
Cuts, notches and holes bored in trusses, structural composite lumber, structural glued-laminated
members and I-joists are prohibited except where permitted by the manufacturer’s recommendations or where the effects of such
alterations are specifically considered in the design of the member by a registered design professional.
